split_audit.note: Source-recording IDs are disjoint. In the current UCA adapter, camera_id is derived from source_recording_id and is not an independently verified physical camera ID; environment_id represents an activity category and may overlap across splits.

manifest.interpretation: This manifest establishes input and configuration provenance. It does not establish annotation validity, forensic suitability, or generalisation to unseen physical cameras.

recording_group_coverage.interpretation: Descriptive held-out recording-level simultaneous coverage. The split-conformal guarantee applies only under exchangeability of recording groups and the same group construction protocol; it is not per-example conditional correctness.

important_note: All conformal artifacts were fitted and calibrated on clean fit and calibration splits only. The same q_hat was reused for clean and distorted test images; no corrupted test data was used for recalibration. Results are robustness measurements on the held-out proxy dataset, not evidence of real-world forensic validity.
